sloka: अतीतसमये काले तस्मिन्वे युधि रावणः ।अमात्यैश्च सुहृद्भिश्च प्राप्तकालममन्यत ॥६-११-२॥।।
transliteration: atītasamaye kāle tasminve yudhi rāvaṇaḥ ।amātyaiśca suhṛdbhiśca prāptakālamamanyata ॥6-11-2॥।।

translations.english: Because of the lapse of time, Ravana considered it imminent to consult with his ministers and friends about war.
